Authentication Required Yes — Contributor-level (or higher) WordPress account

Summary

The Spectra Gutenberg blocks plugin registers custom uagb/ block types whose rendering is driven by a render_callback value that can be influenced by attacker-controlled block content embedded in a post. An authenticated user with Contributor-level privileges can craft a two-block payload naming an arbitrary PHP function as the callback; when the post is rendered (e.g., via preview or on the frontend), WordPress invokes that PHP function, resulting in arbitrary PHP function execution ranging from information disclosure (phpinfo) to command execution (shell_exec, exec, system, passthru).
